claims: Sean Penn won the 2026 Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for his role as Col. Steven J. Lockjaw in One Battle After Another.
The 98th Academy Awards Best Supporting Actor nominees included Sean Penn for One Battle After Another.
The 98th Academy Awards Best Supporting Actor nominees included Benicio del Toro for One Battle After Another.
The 98th Academy Awards Best Supporting Actor nominees included Jacob Elordi for Frankenstein.
The 98th Academy Awards Best Supporting Actor nominees included Delroy Lindo for Sinners.
The 98th Academy Awards Best Supporting Actor nominees included Stellan Skarsgård for Sentimental Value.
Sean Penn secured his third acting Oscar.
One Battle After Another was directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
Sean Penn won at the BAFTAs for his performance in One Battle After Another.
